title.en: Tennessee prisons chief resigns after botched execution attempt
title.zh_hant: 美國田納西州死刑執行失敗風波 懲教部門負責人請辭
title.zh_hans: 美国田纳西州死刑执行失败风波 惩教部门负责人请辞

summary.en: Tennessee’s prisons commissioner is resigning after a botched lethal-injection execution attempt left death-row inmate Christa Pike unconscious on a ventilator. The failed execution triggered a political storm over the state’s death-penalty procedures.
summary.zh_hant: 美國田納西州注射死刑執行失敗，死囚Christa Pike至今昏迷，需用呼吸機維持，州懲教部門負責人宣布請辭；事件引發當地對死刑執行程序的風波。
summary.zh_hans: 美国田纳西州注射死刑执行失败，死囚Christa Pike至今昏迷，需用呼吸机维持，州惩教部门负责人宣布请辞；事件引发当地对死刑执行程序的风波。

title.en: Beacon Peak flat on Beacon Hill burglarized; HK$800,000 in jewelry and cash stolen
title.zh_hant: 畢架山Beacon Peak單位遭爆竊 男戶主失約80萬元珠寶現金
title.zh_hans: 毕架山Beacon Peak单位遭爆窃 男户主失约80万元珠宝现金

summary.en: A flat at Beacon Peak, No. 9 Beacon Hill Road, was burglarized. A 28-year-old male resident reported losing about HK$700,000 in jewelry and HK$100,000 in cash. No arrests have been made and police are investigating.
summary.zh_hant: 畢架山道9號Beacon Peak一個單位遭爆竊，28歲男戶主報稱損失約70萬元珠寶首飾及10萬元現金；暫未有人被捕，警方正調查。
summary.zh_hans: 毕架山道9号Beacon Peak一个单位遭爆窃，28岁男户主报称损失约70万元珠宝首饰及10万元现金；暂未有人被捕，警方正调查。

title.en: Nagoya Asian Games close today; three Hong Kong riders chase jumping final medals
title.zh_hant: 名古屋亞運今日閉幕 港隊三名騎手早上爭場地障礙賽決賽
title.zh_hans: 名古屋亚运今日闭幕 港队三名骑手早上争场地障碍赛决赛

summary.en: The Nagoya Asian Games close today. Hong Kong sits ninth on the medal table with 11 gold, 19 silver and 24 bronze, and three Hong Kong equestrian riders compete in the jumping final this morning.
summary.zh_hant: 名古屋亞運會今日閉幕，港隊於獎牌榜排第九，共得11金19銀24銅；三名港隊馬術代表今日早上出戰場地障礙賽決賽。
summary.zh_hans: 名古屋亚运会今日闭幕，港队于奖牌榜排第九，共得11金19银24铜；三名港队马术代表今日早上出战场地障碍赛决赛。

title.en: One Stanley rebar issue: developer vows rigorous follow-up after Buildings Department findings
title.zh_hant: One Stanley鋼筋質量事件 建灝地產深夜回應：高度重視、嚴肅跟進
title.zh_hans: One Stanley钢筋质量事件 建灏地产深夜回应：高度重视、严肃跟进

summary.en: After the Buildings Department found steel-rebar configuration inconsistent with approved plans at the luxury Stanley project One Stanley, developer K&K (建灝地產) responded late at night, saying it takes the matter highly seriously and will follow it up rigorously. The department earlier warned that professionals or the contractor involved could face prosecution if violations are confirmed.
summary.zh_hant: 屋宇署早前揭發赤柱豪宅項目One Stanley部分獨立屋鋼筋配置與批准圖則不符，發展商建灝地產深夜發表聲明，指對事件高度重視，會嚴肅跟進。屋宇署早前指出，若證實專業人士或承建商違規，可提出檢控。
summary.zh_hans: 屋宇署早前揭发赤柱豪宅项目One Stanley部分独立屋钢筋配置与批准图则不符，发展商建灏地产深夜发表声明，指对事件高度重视，会严肃跟进。屋宇署早前指出，若证实专业人士或承建商违规，可提出检控。

title.en: MIRROR’s Stanley Yau to wed in Southeast Asia this month; band’s first married member
title.zh_hant: 邱士縉月底飛東南亞結婚 成MIRROR首位人夫 雪山唯美婚照曝光
title.zh_hans: 邱士缙月底飞东南亚结婚 成MIRROR首位人夫 雪山唯美婚照曝光

summary.en: MIRROR member Stanley Yau announced he will fly to Southeast Asia with girlfriend Alina to hold their wedding at the end of the month, revealing romantic wedding photos taken in snowy mountains. His bandmates are expected to fly over to witness the ceremony, making him MIRROR’s first married member.
summary.zh_hant: MIRROR成員邱士縉宣布本月底與女友Alina飛往東南亞舉行婚禮，雪山唯美婚照曝光；據悉MIRROR眾兄弟將齊飛當地見證，他將成為MIRROR首位「人夫」。
summary.zh_hans: MIRROR成员邱士缙宣布本月底与女友Alina飞往东南亚举行婚礼，雪山唯美婚照曝光；据悉MIRROR众兄弟将齐飞当地见证，他将成为MIRROR首位「人夫」。

title.en: China Open: Shang Juncheng falls to Zverev in straight sets in second round
title.zh_hant: 中國網球公開賽：商竣程直落兩盤不敵施華利夫 止步次圈
title.zh_hans: 中国网球公开赛：商竣程直落两盘不敌兹维列夫 止步次轮

summary.en: China’s Shang Juncheng lost 0-2 in straight sets to Germany’s Alexander Zverev in the men’s singles second round of the China Open in Beijing on October 3, exiting the tournament.
summary.zh_hant: 中國球手商竣程於北京舉行的中國網球公開賽男單次圈，以0比2直落兩盤不敵德國球手施華利夫，止步第二圈。
summary.zh_hans: 中国球手商竣程于北京举行的中国网球公开赛男单次圈，以0比2直落两盘不敌德国球手兹维列夫，止步第二圈。
